**What is the core idea of this proposal?**
A clear and concise description of the philosophy, section, or concept you want to add or modify.

**Why is this change necessary?**
Explain why the current document falls short and how this addition enhances the Kaal Pillar philosophy.

**Proposed Text/Change**
Provide a draft of the new text or describe the structural change in detail. If you are replacing existing text, please quote it.

**Context / References**
Add any other context, historical references, or scientific concepts that support this proposal.
